analysis.title: Pattern Group Inc. (PTRN) Q3’26 Earnings Review: Strong Execution Continues (NRR 127%), Forward Momentum Anchored on Marketplace Diversification, New Brand Adds & Agentic Commerce
key_insights: GS maintains Buy on Pattern Group (PTRN) with an unchanged 12-month price target of $27, against a price of $17.68 (52.7% upside). The note updates forward estimates for Q3'26 results and management's new outlook.

Q3'26 revenue and Adj. EBITDA came in above both the Street and GS estimates. Management cited technology-driven optimization, geographic and marketplace expansion, new brand partners and broad-based strength.
Q3'26 revenue grew +42% adjusting for the timing of marketplace promotions. Adj. EBITDA was $57mn (6.5% margin) and net revenue retention (NRR) reached 127%.
Management raised FY revenue and Adj. EBITDA guidance. GS reads this as confidence in durable growth with operating leverage.
Diversification is progressing: non-Amazon revenue is about 10% of total revenue, international revenue grew +56% YoY, and SaaS, logistics & other revenue accelerated +136% YoY (to about $18mn).
New brand momentum is strong. Pattern signed as many large brands in the quarter as in its strongest historical full year, average deal size rose +41% YoY and conversion improved 2 points.

Management cited higher conversion from agentic discovery and opportunities across discovery, fulfillment and trust. GS flags agentic commerce as a growth driver, with elevated investment in Pi and agentic capabilities weighing on margins.

Guidance implies deceleration to +34-36% revenue growth and an implied Adj. EBITDA margin of about 5.6%, down from 6.5% in Q3. GS attributes the margin dip to continued elevated technology and R&D spending.
NRR is expected to moderate from 127% in Q3 to about 124-125% exiting the year, implying a stepdown in Q4. Management kept its longer-term NRR framework of about 115%.
International and non-Amazon marketplace growth decelerated sequentially in Q3 because of promotional event timing, tougher European comparisons and the lapping of the Coupang launch.

GS raised estimates: FY26E revenue to $3,516mn (from $3,441mn), FY27E to $4.31bn (from $3.44bn in the note's text), and FY27E Adj. EBITDA to $274mn (from $261mn). Q4'26E revenue goes to $980mn (from $940mn).

The price target cuts the EV/GAAP EBITDA multiple to 16.0x from 20.0x, applied to NTM+1 estimates. GS cites an expected normalization in revenue growth and NRR as the business scales. The 24.0x EV/FCF-SBC leg is unchanged.

Near-term investor debates GS expects: NRR durability as it moderates toward 115%, size and pacing of new brand partner contributions, scaling of non-Amazon marketplaces, and the Adj. EBITDA margin trajectory.
The stock is down 25.3% over 3 months and 24.8% below the S&P 500 over that period, though it is up 29.8% over 6 months.

market_movers.rationale: Buy and $27 PT maintained after Q3'26 beat and raised guidance. Estimates rise, but the target multiple is cut to 16.0x EV/GAAP EBITDA from 20.0x as growth and NRR normalize.

earnings_insights: PTRN Q3'26 reported (printed, results reported 11/4-11/5/2026): revenue $886mn vs GS est $851mn, consensus est $854mn and company guide $840-860mm, about 4% above both GS and consensus.
PTRN Q3'26 reported Adj. EBITDA $57mn (6.5% margin) vs GS est $52mn, consensus est $52mn and guide $51-53mm, 12% above GS and 10% above consensus.

PTRN Q3'26 reported diluted EPS $0.18 vs GS est $0.13 and consensus est $0.15. Operating income $37mn vs GS est $29mn and consensus est $33mn. Gross margin 43.7% was below the GS estimate of 44.3% and in line with consensus 43.7%.
GS estimates (forecast): Q4'26E revenue $980mn (from $940mn), gross profit $426mn (from $409mn), Adj. EBITDA $55mn (from $54mn, 5.6% margin vs 5.8% prior).

GS estimates (forecast): FY26E revenue $3,516mn (from $3,441mn), Adj. EBITDA $220mn (from $213mn), EPS $0.63 (from $0.59). FY27E revenue $4,305mn (from $4,156mn), Adj. EBITDA $274mn (from $261mn), EPS $0.78 (from $0.74). FY28E revenue $5,164mn (from $4,919mn), EPS $1.04 (from $0.94).
Company guidance (as read by GS): implied Q4 revenue growth of +34-36% and implied Adj. EBITDA margin of about 5.6%. NRR guided to about 124-125% exiting the year.
GS forecast growth: total revenue +40.6% in FY26E, +22.4% in FY27E and +20.0% in FY28E. EPS growth +146.4% in FY26E (GS EPS forecast, pre-exceptionals).
risk_factors: Execution on scaling existing brand partner relationships and attracting new partners
NRR moderating faster than expected toward management's ~115% long-term framework

tension_points.bull_case: Q3'26 beat the Street, guidance was raised, SaaS, logistics & other grew +136% YoY, new brand signings matched the strongest historical full year, and margins are expanding despite heavy R&D spend.
tension_points.bear_case: Guidance implies deceleration to +34-36% revenue growth and an Adj. EBITDA margin of about 5.6% vs 6.5% in Q3. NRR is guided down to about 124-125% from 127%, and international and non-Amazon growth slowed sequentially.
tension_points.what_invalidates: GS's downside scenario assumes 9.0x EV/NTM GAAP EBITDA, giving a $15 value, 17% below the current price.
